a full-BV state, Hadamard covariance, particle interpretation, scattering theory or unitarity
a no-go for PT/CPT quantization of pure conformal gravity

the general positive-metric self-adjoint nilpotent no-go

family_counterflow_negative_control.exact_sign_reason: q>0 and q<1/4 imply q^5>0 and 9*q-8<0

nilpotent_positive_metric_no_go.theorem: If eta is strictly positive Hermitian, Q^2=0, and Q^dagger*eta=eta*Q, then Q=0.

provenance.exact_engine: SymPy rational/algebraic matrices; no floating-point decisions

scope.background: selected Berger j=1/2 all-k physical Smith sector and its trace-healthy stationary family
scope.carrier: one exact four-dimensional companion block, occurring twice in the physical quotient
scope.theory: same-field two-phase counterflow changed theory, used only as a negative control

selected_counterflow_negative_control.multiplicity: two identical physical polarizations; one companion block is displayed
selected_counterflow_negative_control.spectral_infeasibility_theorem: eta>0 and H^dagger*eta=eta*H would make every H eigenvalue real; H=iA has nonreal eigenvalues because every A root z has nonzero real part

BRST_compatibility.accepted_chain_gate: C preserves ker(Q) and im(Q), preferably by an explicit graded chain map; this induces C on H^0(Q)
BRST_compatibility.accepted_cohomology_gate: supply explicit pi and i with pi*i=1, Q*i=0, pi*Q=0 (or a proved Hodge representative), then prove positivity of i^dagger*eta*i on H^0(Q)
BRST_compatibility.exact_states_not_positive_null_vectors: a strictly positive metric has no nonzero null vectors, so exact states are removed by cohomology rather than declared null
BRST_compatibility.full_complex_pairing: an indefinite BV/Krein pairing may remain on the nonphysical complex; positivity is a separate cohomology statement
BRST_compatibility.rejected_gate: Q^dagger*eta=eta*Q with eta>0 on a nonzero nilpotent BRST complex
BRST_compatibility.rejection_reason: positive-metric self-adjointness plus Q^2=0 forces ||Qv||_eta^2=<v,Q^2v>_eta=0 for every v, hence Q=0

C_operator_additional_required_data.BRST_chain_map: C_(n+1)*Q_n=Q_n*C_n in every degree, including any nontrivial ghost action
C_operator_additional_required_data.PT_relation: P and the anti-linear T are independently declared; [C,PT]=0 and the convention relating eta, P, and C is proved

eta_candidate_required_data.causal_covariance_gate: a field-theoretic promotion additionally verifies the CCR under the new adjoint and the declared wavefront/support properties
eta_candidate_required_data.invariant_commutant_membership: eta commutes with every declared spatial/internal symmetry generator
eta_candidate_required_data.momentum_frequency_compatibility: opposite momentum/frequency blocks are related by the declared real-field involution, not fitted independently
eta_candidate_required_data.parameter_regularness: eta and eta inverse are nonsingular on the entire declared parameter locus; singular limiting metrics are separate strata
eta_candidate_required_data.pseudo_Hermiticity: H^dagger*eta=eta*H on a declared invariant domain
eta_candidate_required_data.real_structure: for r(v)=R*conjugate(v), require R*conjugate(R)=1 and R^dagger*eta*R=conjugate(eta)
eta_candidate_required_data.strict_positivity_certificate: exact LDL/congruence, principal-minor, sum-of-squares, or equivalent exact proof; numerical eigenvalues are not accepted

forbidden_shortcuts: manufacture eta by diagonalizing each finite matrix independently
call a positive eta a C operator without C^2=1 and the declared P/T relation
infer a field-theoretic state or unitarity theorem from a finite reduced block
replace chain-map/cohomology descent by positive-metric BRST self-adjointness
